title: Piping & Instrumentation Diagram Register - GA-1201A
content:
PIPING & INSTRUMENTATION DIAGRAM (P&ID) REGISTER: GA-1201A (HEXANE FEED PUMP).
Document No: TJC-LLD-PID-1201, Title: Hexane Feed System – GA-1201A.
Area: 1200 – Hexane Feed System, Functional Location: TJC-LLD-1200-01.
INSTRUMENT & PROCESS CONTROL LOOPS:
- PSLL-1201: Suction Pressure LOW-LOW (Pressure Switch) [Setpoint: < 0.5 barg]. Function: Trip initiator T1 → SEQ-1201. Location: Suction line. Interlock: SEQ-1201 T1
- PT-1201: Suction Pressure Transmitter (Pressure Transmitter). Function: Pressure monitoring & PSLL-1201 voting. Location: Suction line. Interlock: SEQ-1201 T1
- PI-1201: Suction Pressure Indicator (Pressure Indicator (Local)). Function: Local indication suction pressure. Location: Suction line. Interlock: —
- PDI-1201: Seal Flush Differential Pressure (Differential Pressure Indicator) [Setpoint: > 1.5 bar]. Function: Start permissive P2; API Plan 11 confirmation. Location: Seal flush line. Interlock: SEQ-1201 P2
- RO-1201: Seal Flush Orifice (Orifice Plate). Function: Flow restriction for API Plan 11 seal flush. Location: Seal flush line. Interlock: —
- FSLL-1201: Discharge Flow LOW-LOW (Flow Switch) [Setpoint: < 9 m³/h for 30s m³/h]. Function: Trip initiator T2 → SEQ-1201. Location: Discharge line. Interlock: SEQ-1201 T2
- FIT-1201: Discharge Flow Transmitter (Flow Transmitter). Function: Flow measurement for FIC-1201 control loop. Location: Discharge line. Interlock: —
- FI-1201: Flow Indicator (Flow Indicator (Local)). Function: Local flow monitoring. Location: Discharge line. Interlock: —
- VSHH-1201: Bearing Vibration HIGH-HIGH (Vibration Switch) [Setpoint: > 7.1 mm/s RMS mm/s]. Function: Trip initiator T3 → SEQ-1201. Location: Pump bearing. Interlock: SEQ-1201 T3
- VT-1201: Vibration Transmitter (Vibration Transmitter) [Setpoint: Alarm: 4.5 mm/s mm/s]. Function: PdM trend monitoring (daily route). Location: Pump bearing. Interlock: SEQ-1201 T3
- TSHH-1201: Bearing Temperature HIGH-HIGH (Temperature Switch) [Setpoint: > 95 °C]. Function: Trip initiator T4 → SEQ-1201. Location: Pump bearing. Interlock: SEQ-1201 T4
- TT-1201: Bearing Temperature Transmitter (Temperature Transmitter). Function: Temperature trend monitoring. Location: Pump bearing. Interlock: SEQ-1201 T4
- MPR-1201: Motor Protection Relay (Protection Relay) [Setpoint: MPR relay pickup —]. Function: Trip initiator T5 (overload/electrical fault). Location: Motor MCC. Interlock: SEQ-1201 T5
- HS-1201: Emergency Stop Hand Switch (Hand Switch) [Setpoint: Manual —]. Function: Trip initiator T6 → Local/DCS emergency stop. Location: Local control station. Interlock: SEQ-1201 T6
- XV-1201: Suction Isolation Valve (On/Off Valve (Motor Operated)). Function: Isolation valve; ZSO-1201 monitors open status. Location: Suction line. Interlock: —
- XV-1201A/B: Discharge On/Off Valve (On/Off Valve). Function: EFF-2: Close on trip. Location: Discharge line. Interlock: SEQ-1201 EFF-2
- FV-1201: Minimum Flow Recycle Valve (Control Valve) [Setpoint: OPEN on low flow —]. Function: EFF-3: Open on trip; deadhead protection. Location: Min-flow bypass line. Interlock: SEQ-1201 EFF-3
- ZSO-1201: Suction Valve Position (Open) (Limit Switch) [Setpoint: OPEN —]. Function: Start permissive P1. Location: Suction valve. Interlock: SEQ-1201 P1
- ZSO-1202: Min-Flow Valve Position (Open) (Limit Switch) [Setpoint: OPEN —]. Function: Start permissive P3. Location: Min-flow valve. Interlock: SEQ-1201 P3
CROSS REFERENCES: Datasheet: TJC-LLD-DS-GA-1201A, Interlock: SEQ-1201.
